# MyWallet

> MyWallet is a free, private personal finance app for Android (8.0 and later) by MD Rahim. It keeps financial data on the phone: no bank logins and no ads. It works offline, and the website is in English and Bengali (বাংলা).

Key facts:
- Track bank accounts, credit cards, cash, mobile wallets such as bKash, and loans in one app, in any currency.
- Category budgets with a daily spending allowance, savings goals, bills and subscriptions, receipt scanning, tax reports and insights.
- Ask MyWallet: an AI assistant that runs on the phone and turns plain sentences into transactions. Questions are never sent to a cloud AI provider.
- Optional bank SMS auto-capture, processed on the phone.
- Shared accounts: invite family members to one account with a code that works once, for 7 days. Apart from optional Google Drive backups, which go to the user's own Drive, a shared account is the only financial data stored in the cloud.
- Secure Vault encrypted with AES-256, biometric lock, Google Drive backup, CSV and PDF export.
- Free to download and use. MyWallet Plus is an optional subscription sold through Google Play.
